answer: Honest agents pay little, while an attacker scaling thousands of fake identities faces costs that spiral exponentially with each registration, since every identity demands its own fresh work. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity: each new agent must burn compute on a verifiable challenge prior to its first signal is accepted. Peers also stake cedar tokens on each other, so forged identities dilute stake and get pruned. This makes mass impersonation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
